description.zh: 对象类型。取值：**Domain**，表示域名。
description.en: The type of the object. Set the value to **Domain**, which indicates a domain name.

description.zh: 要移除的防护对象。多个对象间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The protection asset that you want to remove from a policy. Separate multiple protection assets with commas (,).

description.zh:

description.en:
The ID of the policy.

> You can call the [DescribeSceneDefensePolicies](~~159382~~) operation to query the IDs of all policies.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo detach-scene-defense-object --policy-id 321a-fd31-df51-0000 --object-type Domain --objects www.aliyun.com --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
